response.sql: WITH rt AS (SELECT i.store_id AS store_id, p.rental_id AS rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.store_id, p.rental_id), ra AS (SELECT store_id, rental_id, total, AVG(total) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS avg_total FROM rt) SELECT store_id, SUM(total) AS combined_total, AVG(total - avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM ra WHERE total > avg_total GROUP BY store_id
